task.description:
Validate that PD-05 (Node types) meets all MUST acceptance criteria and is ready for release.

Checks:
1. Confirm `tests/reports/PD-05-test-report.json` shows PASS for all TC-PD-05-01 through TC-PD-05-19.
2. Confirm `zig build` exits 0.
3. Verify each PD-05 acceptance criterion in `docs/requirements/PD-05.md` is traceable to a passing test case.
4. Verify no regression in previously RELEASED requirements (PD-01, PD-02, PD-03) — all previously passing tests must still pass.
5. Check that the NodeType enum rename (USER_TASK → HUMAN_TASK, SCRIPT_TASK → TIMER) did not break any existing PD-01/PD-02 tests.
6. Update PD-05 status to `TESTED` in `docs/status/requirement_status.json` if all checks pass.

If all checks pass:
- Set `result.status = "PASS"`
- Set `result.next_action = "Route to DOC-UPDATER"`

If any check fails:
- Set `result.status = "FAIL"` with blocking issues listed in `result.issues`
acceptance_criteria: All PD-05 MUST acceptance criteria have a passing test case
No regression in PD-01/PD-02/PD-03 test results
PD-05 status updated to TESTED in requirement_status.json

result.summary: PD-05 (Node types) release validation APPROVED. All 19 TC-PD-05 unit tests PASS. zig build exits 0. zig build test exits 0. All MUST acceptance criteria traceable to passing tests. No regression in PD-01/PD-02/PD-03. PD-05 status set to TESTED in requirement_status.json.
